meta.title: Smart city operations
meta.description: Harbourside City streams live readings from roadside, grid and water sensors, nested six levels deep, to one operations centre that sends plans back down.

summary.headline: Every sensor reports through its own controller and system, so the operations centre sees one live feed and can act on any district from one console.
points: Six levels in one frame: city, district, service, system, site and sensors
Controllers act locally first; the city data hub only aggregates and alerts
Operators push signal plans and pump setpoints back down the same chain
The south pumping station opens folded: unfold it, or press 1 to 6 to choose a depth

groups.title: Harbourside City
groups.description: The city boundary: every district, service and device the council operates.

groups.title: North district
groups.description: Dense retail and residential streets around the ring road.

groups.title: Transport
groups.description: Highways, signals and bus priority for the north district.

groups.title: Traffic management
groups.description: Urban traffic control for 140 signalised junctions.

groups.title: Junction 14 cabinet
groups.description: Roadside cabinet at Quay Street and Ring Road East.

groups.title: Roadside sensors
groups.description: Detectors wired straight into the junction cabinet.

groups.title: Energy
groups.description: Distribution grid assets the council monitors with the network operator.

groups.title: Substation N3
groups.description: 11 kV primary substation feeding the north district.

groups.title: South district
groups.description: Docks, light industry and the river crossing.

groups.title: Water
groups.description: Clean water supply and pressure management.

groups.title: Riverside pumping station
groups.description: Booster station that keeps pressure up on the hill zones.

groups.title: Pump control rack
groups.description: PLC rack with its own pressure transducers.

groups.title: Operations centre
groups.description: Staffed around the clock; one console for every service.

data.title: Loop detectors
data.subtitle: Vehicle counts per lane
data.description: Inductive loops cut into each approach lane; they report presence and counts every second.

data.title: Junction camera
data.subtitle: Queue length, cyclists
data.description: Edge-processed video: only queue length and cyclist counts leave the camera, never images.

data.title: Signal controller
data.subtitle: Adapts phase timings
data.description: Runs adaptive timings locally, so the junction keeps working if the link to the centre drops.

data.title: Urban traffic control
data.subtitle: Coordinates corridors
data.description: Balances green waves along the ring road and applies plans the operators choose.

data.title: Feeder load sensor
data.subtitle: Current and voltage
data.description: Monitors load on each outgoing 11 kV feeder.

data.title: Substation gateway
data.subtitle: Aggregates telemetry
data.description: Collects readings from the substation and forwards a summary each minute.

data.title: Pressure transducer
data.subtitle: Outlet main pressure
data.description: Reads outlet pressure ten times a second.

data.title: Pump controller
data.subtitle: Holds the setpoint
data.description: Starts and stops the duty pumps to hold the pressure setpoint.

data.title: Water SCADA
data.subtitle: Alarms and trends
data.description: Supervises every pumping station and reservoir in the south district.

data.title: City data hub
data.subtitle: One live event stream
data.description: Normalises events from every service into one stream and raises cross-service alerts.

data.title: Operator console
data.subtitle: Monitor and act
data.description: Operators watch every district and push plans and setpoints back down.

steps.title: The city in one frame
steps.description: Six levels of boundaries: the city, its districts, each service, its systems, the sites and finally the sensors. The pumping station starts folded.

steps.title: A queue builds at Junction 14
steps.description: Loops and the camera report to the signal controller in the same cabinet, which lengthens the green phase on its own.

steps.title: Traffic control sees the corridor
steps.description: The controller reports its phase to urban traffic control, which publishes a congestion event to the city data hub.

steps.title: Pressure drops at the river
steps.description: Focusing the pumping station unfolds it: the transducer reports to the pump controller, and SCADA raises an alarm on the hub.

steps.title: Grid load in the north
steps.description: The substation gateway summarises feeder load each minute for the hub.

steps.title: Operators act
steps.description: The console shows one live feed. Operators choose a new signal plan for the ring road and raise the pump setpoint.
